added.description:
Why Choose Us?

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.

Our Sustainability Commitment

The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide-ranging initiatives.

Purpose

Job Description

 Why does the position/role exist? –

The Director of Engineering provides leadership and direction for Evergreen’s Engineering functions. This role ensures engineering teams fully use information management systems that connect functional areas and software platforms, increasing standardization and automation across the design, build, sold-order, and problem-solving cycle for all EPE equipment. The Director also leads cross-functional teams to develop, commercialize, and support market-required products and supports Novolex enterprise projects with machinery-related expertise.

Who are the key customers? - Key customers include the EPE customer base, Sales/Marketing, Manufacturing, Field Service, and top management. External customers include major dairy and citrus juice processors and distributors.

 What are the key actions, outputs, deliverables, products and/or services? - Deliverables include engineering services, technical services, and technical manuals. Engineering work should shift resources from administrative, sold-order, and BOM tasks to engineering activities. Products must meet end-customer or Marketing Lead Team functional requirements; applicable sanitation, safety, and electrical codes; project schedules and budgets; and the profit target for each sales order.

Key Accountabilities

Provide a Strategy - Develop and communicate short- and long-term strategies that help Engineering meet or exceed key performance measures and deliver correctly engineered, reliable equipment on time. Align the strategy with customer, market, and competitive needs. Accelerate product development and commercialization while reducing cost and resource requirements through strong leadership, practical judgment, PMI methodology, and innovative thinking.

Customer Satisfaction - Use engineering resources to reduce product nonconformances and improve product reliability and quality, supporting customer satisfaction and lower warranty expense.

Manage the Product Line - Support all Evergreen commercial products by managing sold-order and internal processes, providing technical support to internal and external customers, leading product improvement projects, and supporting manufacturing. Analyze machine and option cost structures to improve margins. Track schedules using Microsoft Project, PMI tools, and daily team discussions. Monitor project budgets using finance data, Excel, and PMI tools.

People Development - Maintain a strong leadership pipeline through high standards for selection and evaluation and effective processes for developing and motivating talent. Continually improve these processes. Build the technical and project management skills of direct reports through field training, one-on-one mentoring, and PMI courses.

Resource Loading Management - Implement and maintain systems that use Engineering’s technical resources effectively and efficiently. Streamline systems and processes to optimize the engineering support required for the product line.

Product Cost Reduction - Drive continuous product cost reduction.

Work Process Redesign - Ensure engineering and documentation teams fully use information management systems that connect functional areas and software platforms, increasing standardization and automation across the design, build, sold-order, and problem-solving cycle for all EPE equipment.

Standards - Work with engineers to establish drafting, design, and part-description standards for all internal and external resources, ensuring product consistency.

Product Data Management - Administer the Engineering Change Order (ECO) workflow, Publications Change Order (PCO) workflow, and related product data management processes.

Technical Manuals - Lead the creation of accurate, user-friendly manuals for packaging equipment. Manage translation projects, provide manuals electronically to Field Service, and use advancing technologies to improve publication usability, accuracy, cost, and delivery.

Key Challenges

The external environment, including technology, competition, markets:

Interfacing with Sales and Marketing to manage the demand for engineered specials

Reducing the number of engineering non-conformances

Maintaining the confidence of the factory and the field

Keeping abreast of advancing technology and using current technology to drive out high dependence on “historical” knowledge within EPE Engineering.

Responding quickly to changing market needs and delivering the right product at the right time. Clear project proposals and detailed scope are critical. Controlling scope creep and related cultural issues remains difficult. The team must reach the market faster with fewer people and lower project funding.

The internal environment, including interaction with others (both inside and outside the company), policies/practices:
Coordinate the sold-order process so Sales, Production Engineering, Manufacturing, and Field Service operate as one cross-functional team rather than separate departments.
Managing demand for engineering resources
Identifying and developing leaders within the Engineering Group
Stage-gating the product improvement process
Use current and advancing technology to reduce dependence on historical knowledge and help team members adopt improved work-system practices and tools.
Engage employees in a process-centered approach that reduces non-value-added work, lowers operating costs, improves quality, and establishes clear accountability.
The work itself, e.g., problems, opportunities, change:

Maintain a broad, long-term view in an environment often focused on short-term needs.

Move work from constant crisis mode to a planned and controlled environment.

Build Engineering’s ability to manage multiple projects of varying complexity.

Scope

Maintain overall budget control for Engineering.

Serve on the Evergreen Lead Team.

Lead and manage the engineering leadership team.

Work with Novolex corporate teams, providing machinery knowledge and experience.

Be the configuration management expert.

Increase machine sales by developing market-relevant, reliable, high-quality products, improving facility profit and ROI. Manage multiple projects and sales orders with a combined project budget above $2 million and sales value above $4 million to deliver double-digit ROI.

Ensure engineering and documentation teams fully use information management systems that connect functional areas and software platforms, increasing standardization and automation across the design, build, sold-order, and problem-solving cycle for all EPE equipment.

Redesign documentation workflows within Engineering to increase electronic automation of sold-order and BOM tasks, shift resources toward engineering work, and reduce administrative effort.

 Reduce Engineering’s dependence on individual “athletes” and historical knowledge by implementing systems, frameworks, standards, and information management tools.

Knowledge And Experience

Four-year engineering degree required; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. Related manufacturing and supply chain experience is required. Proven manufacturing leadership focused on total customer satisfaction is preferred. Project management training, such as PMI Basic Skills, is required.

10-15 years of successful experience managing and leading multiple project teams of technical professionals.

5-10 years of capital machinery design and development experience, including working knowledge of the PMO, 3A standards, and current safety and electrical standards. Five years of high-speed processing or packaging machinery development is preferred.

Experience initiating, negotiating, and managing joint product-development ventures and partnerships with external engineering design firms and equipment developers.

Demonstrated knowledge of current technologies and methods for creating and delivering technical information, including using AI to improve equipment and the customer experience.

 Excellent organizational, verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to achieve results and lead and motivate teams.

 Excellent project management ability.

 Strong knowledge of design, build, and configuration management in the capital equipment build business.

Experience in working with customers both externally and across departments.

Good working knowledge of financial models. Cost accounting and financial justification, both internal and external, are a must to maximize return for the value we offer.

Experience in a custom, capital goods manufacturing environment.

 Demonstrate competence to work with minimal supervision and at all levels in the company.

Consistent track record for achieving results.

Strong information management (IT) skills

The position requires the ability to deal with ambiguity, a willingness to travel, and a dedication to putting in the extra effort needed to meet schedule commitments.

Ability to rapidly change direction, thought process, and focus is a must.

Company Benefits

What You'll Get From Us
Benefits

With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well-being programs may vary depending on where you work.

Community Engagement

At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.

Training and Development

We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization.

Stay ahead of industry trends, technologies, and regulatory developments to maintain competitive advantage.

Strong understanding of GIS applications, CAD tools, asset management systems, and engineering workflows.
Experience managing internal teams and third-party engineering vendors.
Developed leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and lead others.
Knowledge of permitting processes, regulatory requirements, and compliance for fiber deployments.
Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and communicate effectively with executive leadership.
Experience using fiber optic network documentation tools.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.
Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience analyzing and managing large datasets in tools such as PowerBI and Tableau
Experience managing capital budgets.

Your Role On Our Team

The Senior Manager of Data Engineering leads teams that design, build, operate, and continuously improve enterprise data products and platforms. Reporting to the Director of Data Engineering, this leader is accountable for reliable delivery, engineering quality, team development, and strong partnerships across business, analytics, architecture, governance, security, and technology teams.

This role will advance our Databricks-based data platform and establish practical AI-native engineering capabilities. The Senior Manager will use AI-assisted and agentic development approaches to improve how teams design, code, test, document, deploy, monitor, and support data solutions while maintaining appropriate human oversight, security, data governance, and software engineering controls.

Leadership and Team Management

Lead, coach, and develop data engineering managers, technical leads, and engineers; establish clear accountability, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans.
Build an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture grounded in ownership, technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Translate enterprise strategy into priorities, capacity plans, delivery roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
Manage employee and partner capacity, budgets, and vendor relationships to deliver the highest-value work efficiently.
Communicate effectively with executives, business leaders, architects, product leaders, and technical teams.

Data Engineering Strategy and Delivery

Own the delivery and operation of scalable data pipelines, reusable frameworks, curated data products, and platform capabilities supporting analytics, reporting, operational, AI, and machine learning use cases.
Partner with product and business leaders to define outcomes, prioritize demand, manage dependencies, and deliver incremental business value.
Establish engineering standards for architecture, coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, documentation, performance, reliability, and supportability.
Improve delivery predictability through portfolio management, agile planning, transparent metrics, risk management, and disciplined execution.

Guide migration and modernization of legacy data pipelines and warehouse workloads to scalable Databricks patterns where they provide clear value.
Establish reusable ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data quality, deployment, and monitoring frameworks.
Optimize platform performance and cost through workload design, cluster and serverless strategies, usage transparency, and FinOps practices.

AI Native Engineering and AI Enablement

Define and scale responsible AI-assisted development practices across requirements, design, code generation, review, testing, documentation, deployment, and operations.
Evaluate agentic engineering capabilities that automate bounded workflows while preserving human approval, traceability, security, and production controls.
Set measurable adoption and effectiveness goals for AI development tools, including cycle time, quality, test coverage, developer experience, and incident reduction.
Ensure AI-generated code and artifacts meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, maintainability, intellectual property, testing, and peer review.
Partner with AI and data science teams to provide trusted data products, feature pipelines, vector and unstructured data patterns, and model or agent telemetry.

Data Governance Reliability and Security

Embed data ownership, metadata, lineage, classification, access controls, retention, and quality rules into engineering workflows and platform services.
Define service-level objectives and metrics for data freshness, quality, availability, performance, cost, and recovery.
Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, risk, and compliance teams to ensure data products and AI-enabled workflows meet enterprise requirements.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Agile Delivery & Technology PMO (Member Data) will be responsible for owning technology delivery for DataSpring’s Member Data portfolio — how work is taken in, sequenced, staffed, and shipped across new product development, legacy platform replacement, and keep-the-lights-on operations. Member Data and provider delivery operate as two halves of one delivery practice, so this leader partners with the provider-side delivery leader on shared agile standards, common Jira Cloud conventions, and a single set of delivery metrics, and works with business operations and the enterprise PMO (ePMO) to improve the agile process across the whole organization. Success looks like predictable, transparent delivery: onshore and offshore teams on a shared cadence, a Jira Cloud instance leadership trusts as the single source of truth, and a deliberate split between run-the-business and change-the-business capacity. This role sets the standard for how technology delivery gets done at DataSpring, including how the organization uses enterprise-approved generative AI tools, such as Claude, to strip manual effort out of program management.

The Senior Director, Agile Delivery & Technology PMO (Member Data) is a full-time, remote, exempt position

and reports to the VP, Technology

Specific Responsibilities

Owns technology delivery for the Member Data portfolio, from intake and estimation through release, hypercare, and stabilization.
Partners with the provider-side delivery leader to run Member Data and provider delivery as two halves of one practice, with shared agile standards, common Jira Cloud conventions, and one set of delivery metrics.
Works with business operations and the enterprise PMO (ePMO) to improve the agile process across the organization, spanning ideation, prioritization, funding approval, development, and delivery.
Establishes and matures agile ways of working, tailoring Scrum, Kanban, or scaled agile to each team rather than imposing a single framework.
Directs new product development and legacy platform replacement programs, including parallel-running systems, data migration, and customer transition.
Drives offshore development partners and vendors to committed outcomes on throughput, quality, and time-zone-aware delivery.
Balances change-the-business delivery against keep-the-lights-on operations, making capacity allocation explicit and protecting planned work from unmanaged interruptions.
Owns Jira Cloud as the delivery system of record — workflows, issue hierarchy, dashboards, automation, data hygiene — and leads evaluation, selection, and rollout of the broader delivery toolset.
Defines and reports the delivery metrics leadership steers by, including predictability, throughput, cycle time, and portfolio health.
Applies enterprise-approved generative AI to accelerate status synthesis, requirements analysis, documentation, and reporting, and coaches others to do the same.
Leads and develops the delivery staff assigned to the Member Data portfolio, and coaches delivery practitioners across the technology organization.
Drives cross-team dependencies, risks, and escalations to resolution, partnering with product management, engineering, architecture, security, and compliance.

Manages the delivery staff assigned to the Member Data portfolio, with responsibility for team structure, resource alignment, performance, and development.
Oversees offshore delivery partners and staff augmentation vendors, including statement-of-work scope, resource planning, performance management, and escalation.

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Engineering
leads teams responsible for designing and building scalable, cost-effective fiber networks, ensuring all designs meet technical and regulatory standards. This role oversees the entire engineering design process, manages internal teams and external partners, and drives innovation and operational excellence. The Senior Manager is accountable for delivering high-quality, construction-ready designs and maintaining accurate OSP records to support Ziply Fiber’s mission of expanding state-of-the-art fiber networks. Strategic leadership, vendor management, and expertise in fiber network engineering are essential for enabling large-scale deployment and long-term network sustainability

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed.

Program Strategy and Network Design

Provide the end-to-end program direction to organize, develop, and execute a program build across multiple functional teams.
Develop and execute the fiber engineering design strategy in alignment with business expansion and network deployment goals.
Oversee end-to-end design processes, including route planning, permitting, and compliance with federal, state, and local regulations.
Ensure designs are optimized for scalability, cost efficiency, constructability, and long-term maintainability.

Engineering Leadership and Partnerships

Lead and mentor a team of engineering managers, designers, and support staff to deliver high-quality network designs on schedule.
Manage relationships with external engineering vendors, contractors, and consultants, ensuring alignment with company standards and project timelines.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the engineering organization.
Partner with construction, operations, product, and finance teams to align engineering design with deployment readiness and business objectives.
Coordinate and participate in various internal meetings to ensure communication and alignment of initiatives, information sharing and implementation of best practices.

Standards, Compliance, and Project Execution

Establish and enforce engineering design standards, documentation practices, and quality control measures, and oversee adherence to industry best practices and evolving standards in fiber network engineering.
Ensure engineering work orders are designed in compliance with all company standards, NESC, Utility Pole Agreements, and municipal requirements, as well as public ROW or utility easements, and ensure compliance with permitting requirements, safety standards, and environmental regulations. Mitigate risks by proactively identifying engineering challenges and implementing solutions. Oversee the completion of necessary permit applications.
Verify contractor’s invoices for accuracy and process to AP in a timely manner.
Develop, coordinate, and execute project schedules with contractors, property management, customers, vendors, internal stakeholders, municipalities, and government agencies.

Drive innovation in design methodologies, leveraging automation, GIS platforms, and advanced engineering tools, and implement best-in-class workflows to improve speed, accuracy, and efficiency of design deliverables. Establish and manage process indicators and performance metrics to optimize workflows.
Stay ahead of industry trends, technologies, and regulatory developments to maintain competitive advantage.

High school diploma or GED.
Minimum six (8) years of progressive experience in fiber network engineering, including quoting, permitting, and other pre-construction activities.
Minimum of three (3) years in a leadership/people management capacity, with demonstrated experience mentoring, developing, and managing engineering teams.
Proven expertise in large-scale fiber design, route and build planning, permitting, and construction-ready deliverables.
Strong understanding of GIS applications, CAD tools, asset management systems, and engineering workflows.
Experience managing internal teams and third-party engineering vendors.
Developed leadership skills, with the ability to mentor and lead others.
Knowledge of permitting processes, regulatory requirements, and compliance for fiber deployments.
Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and communicate effectively with executive leadership.
Experience using fiber optic network documentation tools.
Understanding of network Engineering and inventory tools
Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10% of the time).
The schedule for this position is Monday through Friday with weekend availability as needed to complete the essential duties of this role.
Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license, auto insurance, and satisfactory driving record.

Professional Engineer (PE) license.
Experience analyzing and managing large datasets in tools such as PowerBI and Tableau
Experience managing capital budgets.

Ability to work independently and apply sound judgment and reasoning skills to a variety of situations.
Ability to collaborate effectively with other personnel to meet deadlines.
Strong verbal and written communication, attention to detail, and organizational skills.
Operate from a customer centered mindset
Ability to lead and guide change within an organization

Pinterest is seeking a Sr. Manager to lead our Capacity Engineering team. The team ensures that Pinterest’s cloud infrastructure has the capacity it needs while operating reliably, efficiently and with clear financial accountability. You’ll lead the full portfolio across forecasting and supply, capacity-management systems, compute and GPU efficiency, infrastructure data and governance and capacity operations.

Lead the Capacity Engineering team and establish its 12–18 month functional and technical strategy, roadmap and success measures tied to Infrastructure and company goals.

Improve utilization and efficiency across Kubernetes-based shared compute platforms, GPU infrastructure and other cloud environments while protecting availability and developer velocity.
Establish trusted metrics and operating practices for capacity risk, allocation, infrastructure cost, realized savings and system health.
Partner with Infrastructure, SRE, Finance, product and platform teams and cloud providers to make capacity and infrastructure-investment decisions.
Plan team structure and longer-term headcount; recruit and close senior talent; develop technical leaders; and sustain an inclusive, accountable and high-performing team.
Use AI to accelerate capacity analysis, forecasting, operational investigations and repeatable team workflows while applying judgment and verification to ensure quality.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related field or equivalent experience.
Experience managing and developing teams that build or operate large-scale cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, compute platforms or resource-management systems.
Experience defining a 12-18 month functional and technical strategy tied to organizational goals and delivering results through senior technical leaders across a broad infrastructure portfolio.
Technical experience in public-cloud infrastructure, highly available distributed systems, Kubernetes or shared-compute platforms and capacity-management systems.
Experience leading cross-functional infrastructure programs and communicating availability, cost and capacity tradeoffs to Engineering, Finance, SRE and cloud-provider stakeholders.

Financial Management and Reporting

Drive Results by managing an efficient and profitable operation with a focused approach on revenue maximization and profitability using cost control measures in accordance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
Achieve Encore’s financial goals for the location(s) by effectively managing labor, equipment sub-rentals and other costs.

Anticipate equipment challenges and changes in a timely and professional manner.

Prepare and deliver compelling presentations that convey the value of Encore and effectively solve customer challenges.
Effectively prepare and present quotes and proposals in a timely manner to customers, including those submitted through www.encoreglobal.com, venue booking system, or other sources as assigned.
Attend site visits, pre-conference planning meetings, and appropriate venue meetings as necessary to support the customer event experience.
Collaborate with vendors and other departments/divisions of the company to capture and service events.
Understand event cost structure and incorporate into solution designs according to established profitability guidelines.
Attend customer meetings, understanding their goals and responding to their questions, concerns, and challenges.
Do the Right Thing by ensuring all customer information is up to date and accurate in the Customer Relationship Management system (CRM) at all times.
Maintain knowledge of new product/service offerings and emerging technology supporting meetings and events.
Create and present information and reports, as needed, to senior management related to performance, pipeline, forecasting, etc.

Customer Service

Deliver World-Class Service by cultivating and maintaining relationships with customers, venue personnel and various Encore supporting functions and departments.
Position will have oversight to personnel to assist with event execution.
Exceed the expectations and needs of internal and external customers.

Build the Future of Digital Healthcare

Technology should make healthcare easier—not more complicated.
Every day, hundreds of thousands of patients rely on Aeroflow Health to access life-changing medical products and clinical services. Behind every prescription fulfilled, every order placed, and every patient served is technology that must be secure, scalable, intuitive, and remarkably reliable.

As Director, Digital Commerce Engineering
, you'll lead the engineering organization responsible for those experiences. You'll develop exceptional Engineering Managers, strengthen the platforms that power our digital ecosystem, and help build technology that removes friction from healthcare for patients across the country.
If you're passionate about growing leaders, building high-performing engineering organizations, and delivering technology that makes a measurable difference in people's lives, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity

At Aeroflow, engineering isn't a support function—it's a strategic driver of our growth.
Our Digital Product Engineering organization builds the customer-facing platforms that power experiences across Mom & Baby, Sleep, Urology, and our digital commerce ecosystem. As we continue to grow, we're investing in the leaders, systems, and engineering practices that will define our next chapter.

As Director, Digital Commerce Engineering
, you'll lead Engineering Managers responsible for building secure, scalable, and resilient digital products while helping elevate the engineering culture, technical direction, and operational excellence of the organization.
This role is designed for a leader who enjoys balancing strategy with execution—someone who can develop people, simplify complexity, improve engineering systems, and create alignment across technical and business teams.
Working alongside leaders across Technology, Product, UX, Security, Data, and Operations, you'll help shape how engineering delivers value throughout the business while ensuring every investment ultimately improves the customer experience.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Your success won't be measured by the code you write.

It will be measured by:

the Engineering Managers you develop,
the teams you build,
the platforms your organization delivers,
and the patient experiences those products make possible.

Build Exceptional Engineering Teams

Remove obstacles, improve execution, and help teams deliver consistently with confidence and quality.

Identify opportunities to simplify architecture, improve scalability, and strengthen platform consistency.
Guide modernization efforts that improve long-term platform health while creating optimal patient experiences.
Balance strategic investments with near-term delivery commitments and business priorities.

Ensure engineering remains deeply connected to the outcomes that matter most.

Drive Operational Excellence

Scale delivery practices that enable teams to move faster without sacrificing quality.
Champion security, privacy, and compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.

Balance long-term thinking with disciplined execution.

Build alignment without relying on authority.

Leave every team stronger than you found it.

The best candidates for this role don't simply manage engineering teams—they create environments where exceptional engineers and engineering leaders can thrive.

Invest in people before processes.
Build trust before driving change.
Challenge ideas while strengthening relationships.

Make the people around you better.

Every improvement your teams make—whether increasing platform reliability, simplifying the customer experience, accelerating software delivery, or developing future engineering leaders—helps more patients access the healthcare products and services they depend on.
You'll join a company that's investing heavily in technology, committed to developing exceptional leaders, and building an engineering organization where talented people can do the best work of their careers.
